rationale: Micah brings deep expertise in visual interfaces for complex systems (d3.js, WebXR, ML tooling) while Kshitij has specialized knowledge in protocol verification and systems-level design at scale — complementary skill sets for building tools that make intricate technical domains more intuitive. At a physical AI hack event, Micah's conviction that interactive visualization unlocks AI's business potential could align with Kshitij's need to hire verification engineers who think beyond traditional HDL workflows.
intro_message: Micah Stubbs, meet KSHITIJ GUPTA — a design verification engineer at NVIDIA with deep protocol expertise who's looking to hire IP/CPU verification talent, and you build visual interfaces for complex ML and data systems.
